session_spawn.title: Start an agent on a task
session_spawn.description: Start an agent on a task. Writes a session entity, a first entry naming the provider, model and effort, and the session’s claim on the task; committing that starts the agent, so a task another session already holds refuses the whole request. With wait, returns how the run ended (its brief and its exit code) instead of the session id.

task.description: the task to hand to the agent, which the session claims

provider.description: the provider that runs the agent; one whose transport is a command line

effort.description: the reasoning effort, where the model accepts such a setting

instruction.description: what to tell the agent (default: the task’s id and title; it holds the claim and reads the rest itself)

wait.description: block until the run is over and return how it ended

timeout.description: how long to wait: 45m, 2h, or bare seconds (default 30m)

session_wait.title: Wait for a session to end
session_wait.description: Wait for a session to end, then return its brief and the exit code its run ended with. A session still running when the timeout passes is reported as still running, never killed.

timeout.description: how long to wait: 45m, 2h, or bare seconds (default 30m)

session_peek.title: Read the end of a session
session_peek.description: Return the last entries of a session as the graph holds them, one line per entry, plus its current status. Reads a bounded number of entries, never the provider’s own log file.

lines.description: how many entries to return, newest last (default 40)
